training.secondary_seed: Repeat selected qualifying external arm and matched real-only control

executed_design.geometry: relative per-axis IQR and local-neighbor scale; label-blind nearest-history; six daughters; symmetric pair head
executed_design.images: shared triplanar 12x12 encoder, explicit three-frame validity per center; actual parent and daughter crops
executed_design.detection: same shared compact convolutional encoder, center and subvoxel-offset heads, native static patches
executed_design.zoo_split: contiguous first 70% train; 6-frame purge; next 15% validation; 6-frame purge; last 15% diagnostic test; one acquisition per species
executed_design.synthetic_split: preserve prepared train; split prepared holdout into validation/test by sample hash
executed_design.decoder: local binary event-gain maximization with no-op, parent/daughter/displaced-owner conflicts and protected 2-frame incumbent fork windows
executed_design.detector_integration: bounded center refinement then rebuild all graph-dependent evidence using incumbent native and v3 inference; isolated population change test
executed_design.source_calibration: external validation temperature; real folds reused, no independent inner fold claim
executed_design.selection: C4 is prespecified primary external arm; all primary arms frozen before target scoring; seed2 if an external arm qualifies
executed_design.resource_adjustment: 29 GiB available disk; compact uint8 patch caches; default full update budgets retained
